en la nube = in the cloud
oferta y demanda = supply and demand
a propósito = by the way / on purpose
una fuente fiable = a reliable source
open-minded = de mente abierta Open-minded is also de mente abierta.
confident = seguro de sí mismo The list says "confident", but confident is seguro de sí mismo.
fijar una fecha; to repair = arreglar
Plant, problem, family or maths. Plural: raíces
Also: to hit. Copiar y pegar = copy and paste
guardar un archivo; guardar un secreto
Written in Roman numerals: siglo XXI

Before a masculine noun: el primer día

el becario = the intern, grant holder
el alma but feminine: el alma gemela
Also compromise. Anillo de compromiso = engagement ring.

sentences.translation: Don't be so impulsive: think before you buy.

sentences.text: Es muy ___: no perdona nunca.
sentences.translation: He's very resentful: he never forgives.

sentences.text: Es una persona ___: habla poco de su vida.
sentences.translation: She's a reserved person: she says little about her life.

sentences.text: Es tan ___ que repite el informe cinco veces.
sentences.translation: She's such a perfectionist that she redoes the report five times.

sentences.text: Se puso ___ al ver las fotos de su infancia.
sentences.translation: He got nostalgic looking at photos from his childhood.

sentences.text: Está ___ porque no encuentra trabajo.
sentences.translation: He's discouraged because he can't find a job.

sentences.text: Me quedé ___ con el final de la serie.
sentences.translation: I was disappointed with the ending of the series.

sentences.text: Tiene un carácter ___: grita por cualquier cosa.
sentences.translation: He has a hot temper: he shouts about anything.

sentences.text: El jefe quedó muy ___ con los resultados.
sentences.translation: The boss was very pleased with the results.

sentences.text: Está ___ porque lleva una hora esperando.
sentences.translation: He's irritated because he's been waiting an hour.

sentences.text: Intenta ___ antes de tomar una decisión.
sentences.translation: Try to reason before making a decision.

sentences.text: Cada persona puede ___ el poema de forma distinta.
sentences.translation: Each person can interpret the poem differently.

sentences.text: Soy ___ de que el plazo es muy corto.
sentences.translation: I'm aware that the deadline is very short.

sentences.text: El herido estaba ___ cuando llegó la ambulancia.
sentences.translation: The injured man was unconscious when the ambulance arrived.

sentences.text: Es muy ___: se pasó la parada del autobús.
sentences.translation: He's very distracted: he missed his bus stop.

sentences.text: Eso no es un hecho, es solo una ___.
sentences.translation: That's not a fact, it's just an assumption.

sentences.text: Mi ___ me dice que algo no va bien.
sentences.translation: My intuition tells me something isn't right.

sentences.text: Tuve una ___ y llamé justo a tiempo.
sentences.translation: I had a hunch and called just in time.

sentences.text: La nueva ley generó mucha ___.
sentences.translation: The new law caused a lot of controversy.

sentences.text: Se notaba la ___ entre los dos equipos.
sentences.translation: You could feel the tension between the two teams.

sentences.text: Hubo un ___ y nos quedamos sin luz dos horas.
sentences.translation: There was a blackout and we had no power for two hours.

sentences.text: España suele ___ aceite de oliva a todo el mundo.
sentences.translation: Spain usually exports olive oil all over the world.

sentences.text: El país tiene que ___ gas del extranjero.
sentences.translation: The country has to import gas from abroad.

sentences.text: Esa fábrica se dedica a ___ piezas de coche.
sentences.translation: That factory manufactures car parts.

sentences.text: Trabaja en el ___ de recursos humanos.
sentences.translation: She works in the human resources department.

sentences.text: Es un profesor muy ___ con los deberes.
sentences.translation: He's a very demanding teacher about homework.

sets.name: Datos personales y etapas de la vida

confusions.explanation: Suceso means an event or incident; success is éxito.
Desierto is a desert; dessert is postre.
Ambicioso means ambitious; ambiguous is ambiguo.
Resumir means to summarize; to resume (start again) is reanudar.
Decepcionado means disappointed; deceived is engañado.
Asombrado means amazed; ashamed is avergonzado.
Premio is a prize or reward; price is precio.
Habilidad is a skill or ability; a habit is un hábito.
Harina is flour; a flower is una flor.
Pantalla is a screen; trousers are pantalones.
Soledad is solitude or loneliness; solidarity is solidaridad.
Envidioso means envious of what others have; celoso means jealous, especially in love.
Confiado means trusting, sometimes overconfident; self-confident is seguro de sí mismo.
Ilusionado means excited or hopeful, not disillusioned (desilusionado).
Pelear means to fight; to argue is discutir.
Despedir means to fire or dismiss someone; despedirse means to say goodbye.
Comprobar means to check or verify; to prove is demostrar.
Fijar means to fix in place or set (a date); to repair is arreglar.
Aprobar means to pass an exam; suspender means to fail it (in Spain).
Fecha is a calendar date; a date with someone is una cita.
Sabiduría is wisdom; knowledge is el conocimiento.
Nieve is snow; a niece is una sobrina.
Guardar means to save a file or keep something; to save money is ahorrar.
